svg.title: What capshelf writes into a project
svg.desc: Skills, Pi extensions, and subagents are copied from the data repo into project files. Settings, MCP, and Codex config fragments are merged into .claude/settings.json, .mcp.json, and .codex/config.toml, which keep their project-local values.
